source.manualTitle: Insignia NS-TDRE75W1 / NS-TDRG75W1 Vented Dryer Service Manual

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before accessing internal components.

steps.title: Continue procedure
steps.body: Service test mode entered. Continue with component checks below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: After service test entry, proceed with OEM component test steps.

steps.title: Service test — screen 04 NTC
steps.body: Enter service test mode (Time Adjust + and Wrinkle Care within 3s after Power; display shows St). Press Time Adjust + until screen 04. E5 displays on NTC fault; otherwise current outlet temp is shown.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Screen 04, NTC test. If NTC error, error code E5 will show up.

steps.title: Bench outlet NTC at CN3
steps.body: Disconnect power. Outlet NTC at CN3 pins 1–2 (TEMP_OUT). Spec: ~50 kΩ @ 77°F (40 kΩ @ 86°F, 99 kΩ @ 50°F).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power. Outlet NTC at CN3 pins 1–2 (TEMP_OUT). Spec: ~50 kΩ @ 77°F (40 kΩ @ 86°F, 99 kΩ @ 50°F).

steps.title: Outlet NTC resistance
steps.body: Measure CN3 TEMP_OUT (pins 1–2) at room temperature.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Thermistor resistance 50KΩ @ 77°F. If infinity, replace thermistor.

branches.label: Out of spec
branches.oemOutcome: Replace outlet thermistor — E5 fault (A/D <10 or >1000).

branches.label: Borderline
branches.oemOutcome: Replace outlet thermistor — E5 fault (A/D <10 or >1000).

branches.label: Open circuit
branches.oemOutcome: Replace outlet thermistor — E5 fault (A/D <10 or >1000).

steps.title: Inspect CN3 harness
steps.body: Verify CN3 harness between main PCB and outlet NTC. Repair opens/shorts; retest screen 04 in service mode.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify CN3 harness between main PCB and outlet NTC. Repair opens/shorts; retest screen 04 in service mode.

steps.title: Replace outlet NTC
steps.oemOutcome: Replace outlet temperature sensor and retest service mode 04.

steps.title: Outlet NTC verified
steps.oemOutcome: Bench reading in spec and/or service test 04 shows temp without E5.
